include.description: Additional packaged files and directories, also available through `Package.path`.

publish.description: Whether this package may be published.

Package.description: A package identity and its source and publication layout.

path.description: A local directory, or a subdirectory of the fetched repository or archive.

package.description: The selected package name when it differs from the import alias.

rev.description: A complete lowercase Git commit hash.

url.description: An HTTPS or local file archive URL.

workspace.description: Selects the same alias from the enclosing workspace catalog.

tools.description: Explicitly authorizes this dependency's sandboxed build tools.

Dependency.description: One path, pinned Git commit, pinned archive, or workspace catalog entry.

members.description: Package directories or globs relative to this manifest.

silk-version.description: The compiler version selected for workspace members.

dependencies.description: Fully specified dependency sources shared by workspace members.

Workspace.description: A workspace's member paths and dependency catalog.

archive.description: Archives keyed by their package-local names.

Native.description: Native files fetched from pinned archives; compilation and linking are graph operations.

url.description: The portable archive URL, absent when using target-specific pins.

strip.description: The number of directory components removed during extraction.

Archive.description: One portable archive pin or a table of pins selected by target triple.

url.description: An HTTPS or local file URL.

runtimes.description: Named runtime modules declared by the package.

defaults.description: The runtime names selected by default.

module.description: The module declaring the retained value or function.

Retention.description: A declaration kept even when no ordinary source import reaches it.

next-steps.description:
The steps `silk init` suggests running in the new project, in order, after `cd` into it;
empty to suggest nothing.

Template.description:
Settings read only when `silk init` creates a project from this manifest's directory; the new
project's manifest does not keep them.

run.description: The command, one line as the developer types it.

description.description: What the command does, one line printed beside it; absent to print the command alone.

NextStep.description:
One step `silk init` suggests running in a project created from a template.

# Details

A template writes each step as a table in `[template].next-steps`, such as
`{ run = "silk task dev", description = "start the dev server" }`. `silk init` prints the
command, then the description dimmed in a column beside it.

Tool.description:
An external tool's table, accepted without interpreting its keys or values.
Decoding discards its contents; a manifest editor must preserve the source document.
